claims.location: source name, all 123 rows (41 raw x 3 channels)
claims.value: Jurkat_<shRNA>_<HIV|mock>_set<n> (9 sources: 3 SILAC sets x 3 channels)
claims.evidence: PRIDE: 'Equal amount of SILAC labeled proteins from different conditions were mixed as one set of 3plex SILAC sample, 3 sets in total.' Supplementary Table 4 names SILAC set 1, 2, 3 and the condition of each channel. Each (set, channel) is one labelled cell culture lysate, so each source name denotes one physical sample; the sh-Ctr mock medium channel recurs in every set but as a separately labelled culture per set.

claims.value: set1: L = sh-Ctr HIV-infected, M = sh-Ctr mock, H = sh-NLRX1#1 mock; set2: L = sh-NLRX1#1 HIV-infected, M = sh-Ctr mock, H = sh-NLRX1#1 mock; set3: L = sh-NLRX1#2 HIV-infected, M = sh-Ctr mock, H = sh-NLRX1#2 mock
claims.evidence: Explicit label statement: Supplementary Table 4 row 6 headers over the ratio columns: set 1 'Ratio M/L' = 'sh-Ctr mock/sh-Ctr infection', 'Ratio H/L' = 'sh-NLRX1#1 mock/sh-Ctr infection', 'Ratio H/M' = 'sh-NLRX1#1 mock/sh-Ctr mock'; set 2 M/L 'sh-Ctr mock/sh-NLRX1#1 infection', H/L 'sh-NLRX1#1 mock/sh-NLRX1#1 infection', H/M 'sh-NLRX1#1 mock/sh-Ctr mock'; set 3 M/L 'sh-Ctr mock/sh-NLRX1#2 infection', H/L 'sh-NLRX1#2 mock/sh-NLRX1#2 infection', H/M 'sh-NLRX1#2 mock/ sh-Ctr mock'. The three ratios of each set are mutually consistent (one condition per channel). Data checks: (1) HIV-1 proteins in the deposited HIV-only search proteinGroups_NLRX1.txt: POL_HV1H2 Intensity L/M/H = 1.77e10/5.2e8/2.5e8 (SILAC1), 9.75e9/3.1e8/1.05e9 (SILAC2), 1.41e10/4.7e8/4.7e8 (SILAC3); GAG_HV1H2 L-only in SILAC2/3 -> light = infected in every set. (2) NLRX1 (Q86UT6) in Supplementary Table 4: set1 H/M 0.226 (knockdown heavy vs control medium), M/L 0.46 (infection raises NLRX1, as the paper reports); set2 M/L 3.09 (light knocked down) and H/M 0.228; set3 H/M 0.459, H/L 0.49 -> knockdown channels as labelled. Paper Methods: 'SILAC-labeled Jurkat-sh-Ctr or Jurkat-sh-NLRX1 cells were infected with VSV-G-NL4-3-Luc (MOI=5) or left uninfected. At 24 hpi, cells were harvested'.

limitations: PARTIAL SCOPE: only the 41 SILAC raw files (2017*_Ting_*) are annotated. The 24 TMT11plex raw files 20200718_Haitao_TMT_F1..F24.raw (sh-FASTKD5 vs control, infected/mock; Q Exactive HF-X per paper; MaxQuant 1.6.10.43 parameters_FASKD5.txt / proteinGroups_FASTKD5.txt) are out of scope for the SILAC campaign and excluded; recorded in BLOCKED.md.

Raw file -> SILAC set mapping (Ting_n = SILAC set n / MaxQuant experiment SILACn) is inferred from file names plus the set-depth consistency check; no deposited summary.txt/experimentalDesign states it. If it were wrong, sets 2 and 3 differ only in hairpin (#1 vs #2); set 1 differs in the light channel (sh-Ctr vs sh-NLRX1 infected).

The deposited SILAC search (parameters_NLRX1.txt, MaxQuant 1.6.0.16) used an HIV-1-only FASTA (UniProt UP000002241) and yields only HIV Gag/Pol; the human SILAC search behind Supplementary Table 4 (MaxQuant 1.5.3.17 per PRIDE) is not deposited. Modifications are identical in both descriptions. Which raw files entered either search (e.g. the total runs and the fraction-12 re-injection) is not recorded.

Deposited fractions are incomplete relative to the protocol's 15 pooled fractions: set 2 has 01-09 only, set 3 has 01-13, set 1 has 01-16 (one more than 15). Fraction identifiers follow the file suffix.

20170404_Ting_1_12_170408070646.raw is interpreted as a second injection of set 1 fraction 12 (technical replicate 2) from the Xcalibur duplicate-name suffix; 20170413_Ting_2_total1/total2 as unfractionated injections of set 2 (technical replicates 2/3) from the name and the different LC method. Neither is described in any text.

Biological replicate numbering assumes the medium sh-Ctr mock channel (and the heavy sh-NLRX1#1 mock channel of sets 1 and 2) were separately grown cultures per set; the paper only says 'Samples were run in biological duplicates' (Fig. 4b) without per-channel detail.
characteristics[culture medium] = not available: the base medium of the SILAC (Lys/Arg-depleted) medium is not named; standard Jurkat culture is RPMI 1640.
PRIDE's 'SILAC medium/heavy' reagent sentence calls 13C6 15N2 'L-arginine (K8)'; read as lysine from the K8 code and the 3plex K4R6/K8R10 design.
VSV-G-pseudotyped single-round HIV-1 NL4-3-Luc is encoded at species level (NCBITaxon:11676); the pseudotyping, MOI 5 and reporter are recorded here only.
